meta.title: Ámbar Recoleta
meta.description: Restaurant, bar and dance floor across from the Recoleta Cemetery. Junín 1725, Buenos Aires.

hero.titulo: We're a bar and a restaurant
hero.bajada: We're your dinner, your pre-drinks and, if the night calls for it, everything that comes after.
hero.lugar: Junín 1725, across from the Recoleta Cemetery.

patio.texto: On Saturdays we open at {hora}. The patio is for starting early: a vermouth, some oysters, the aperitivo menu.

cena.titulo: French cooking, with a local accent.
cena.texto: Plates to share, bold and fresh flavors. Order two at a time and let them keep coming.

previa.titulo: Drinks for drinking, not for looking at.
previa.texto: Clear flavors, no clarifications, no ceremony. Finish it and order another.

despues.etiqueta: And, if the night calls for it
despues.texto: Fridays and Saturdays, live DJs from {hora}. Every set is recorded and aired on Colonia Radio.

fotos.barraCopasLuz: Three martini glasses filled with ice on the bar, the warm light of the arch reflected on the marble.
fotos.djSetLiving: A DJ plays at the back of the room while people chat on the couches.
fotos.espressoMartiniColonia: An espresso martini resting on a turntable slipmat with the Colonia Radio logo.
fotos.mesaCena: A table set for four, with green velvet folding chairs and a lit candle.
fotos.ostrasMarmol: Three oysters with herbs on a marble table, next to a drink and a sauce.
fotos.patioTarde: Tubular chairs with orange cushions on the patio, in the late-afternoon light.
fotos.platosCenital: A full table seen from above: beef Wellington, steak au poivre with fries and duck breast on vintage porcelain.
fotos.platosOstrasPapas: Oysters, fries, tuna tataki and a drink on a table, with the blue curtain behind.
fotos.rinconCuero: A leather armchair next to a small wooden table with a lit lamp.
fotos.salonCortina: The dining room by candlelight: white tablecloths, globe wall lamps and a velvet curtain.
fotos.tragosDeLaCasa: Five house cocktails on a table, with the blue curtain behind.

carta.bajada: French cooking with a local accent, made for sharing. Clear drinks, no ceremony.
carta.precios: Prices in Argentine pesos, for reference: the menu changes often and today's is at the bar.

buscar.pista: A dish, a drink or an ingredient

espacio.bajada: Nearly 500 square meters across from the Recoleta Cemetery. Three rooms, one night.

patio.texto: Palms lit from below that cast shadows on the wall, leather armchairs and chairs that don't match, on purpose. With the sky above when the weather allows.

salon.titulo: For a dinner that takes its time.
salon.texto: White tablecloths, globe wall lamps, candles on the tables and blue velvet curtains. Booths for staying on after dessert.

barra.texto: The marble bar under the arch of light. Up front, the Colonia Radio booth faces the street: DJs play live and every set is recorded.

visitanos.titulo: Junín 1725, across from the Recoleta Cemetery.
visitanos.mapa: Sketch of the block: Ámbar is at Junín 1725, on the sidewalk across from the Recoleta Cemetery.
visitanos.reservasTexto: Book your table online, through Meitre.
visitanos.eventosTexto: We host private events. Tell us the date, how many you are and what you have in mind.
visitanos.eventosMensaje: Hi! I'd like to ask about a private event at Ámbar.

musica.bajada: Fridays and Saturdays, live DJs from {hora}. We don't tell the DJ what to play.

colonia.texto: Colonia Radio is a streaming project for DJs, electronic and vinyl alike. The booth is up front, facing the street: whatever plays live is streamed and recorded.

sets.nota: No brief: no quiet dinner music, no reggaeton at midnight. Every DJ chooses.

noEncontrada.texto: The page you're looking for isn't here. The menu is.

experiencias.bajada: A night at Ámbar, for someone else. Pay here and they get a code to show at the bar.
experiencias.demo: Demo content for a university project: Ámbar does not sell experiences online today.
pasos: Choose the experience and pay with Mercado Pago.
You get a code per experience, valid for the quantity you bought.
Whoever receives it shows the code at Ámbar.

eventos.bajada: Birthdays, company dinners, small weddings or a night for your people. Tell us what you have in mind and we'll get back to you.
eventos.demo: University project demo: inquiries from this form do not reach Ámbar. For a real event, message them on WhatsApp.
eventos.ayudaMensaje: Time, dinner or just the bar, anything special…

exito.texto: We'll write to {email} to plan it. To speed things up, send us the summary on WhatsApp.

eventos.mensajeWhatsApp: Hi! I wrote to you from the website about an event: {tipo} for {personas} people on {fecha}. I'm {nombre}.

errores.fecha_lejana: We take inquiries up to a year ahead.
errores.personas_maximo: For more than 300 people, message us on WhatsApp.
errores.red: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errores.general: We couldn't send your inquiry. Please try again later.

carrito.vacio: You haven't chosen any experience yet.
carrito.agotada: No longer available: remove it to continue.
carrito.datosTexto: We show you the codes after payment, and they stay on the order link.
carrito.seguro: Payment happens on Mercado Pago: Ámbar never sees or stores your card details.
carrito.nota: University project test: use a Mercado Pago test account.

errores.sin_cupos: Not enough spots left for one of the experiences. Lower the quantity.
errores.experiencia_no_disponible: One of the experiences is no longer on sale. Remove it from the cart.
errores.pago_no_disponible: Mercado Pago didn't respond. Please try again later.
errores.red: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errores.general: We couldn't start the payment. Please try again.

pedido.pagadoTexto: These are your codes. Whoever gets the gift shows the code at Ámbar.
pedido.pendienteTexto: Mercado Pago lets us know in a few seconds. No need to reload.
pedido.demoraTexto: This is taking longer than usual. Keep this link: once the payment clears, the codes show up here.
pedido.rechazadoTexto: Nothing was charged. You can try again.
pedido.senaPagadaTexto: We got the deposit. We'll write to you to settle the event details.
pedido.guardar: Keep this link: it's your receipt.

sena.texto: To hold the date, pay the agreed deposit.
sena.pagar: Pay the deposit with Mercado Pago
sena.yaPagada: This deposit is already paid. Thank you!
sena.cerrada: This link is no longer valid. Ask us for a new one.
sena.error: We couldn't start the payment. Please try again.
